Network Service Group Resource Edit Network Service Group
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/networkServiceGroups/:serviceGroupId

Updates the network service group information for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
serviceGroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the network service group.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation
